Postponed style variants: the decision page (#516)

Five items come back before the release (owner, 2026-10-29). For each: the current game look (left, green frame, from mise run shots current on develop 2026-10-30) against the postponed variants (right, frames of the original mockups). Note: the "Now" of the old mockups is the look before 2026-10-21; what the game shows now is the variant chosen then, so the chosen variant is also shown in its mockup for a fair comparison. Each item ends with a recommendation and the decision field. Nothing here changes a rule, the simulation or the protocol; where a variant would need data, it says so.

How the recommendations were made: each variant against the current frame on the same points (does it read in grayscale, is a meaningful sign at least 20 px, does it fight with the signs already at a city or a fight, what it costs per frame, what it needs from the view), the structure of a design critique (first impression, hierarchy, consistency with the language of icons of ui-style 21, accessibility). Several items were partly absorbed by the work done since 2026-10-21 (#349, #330, #352, DEC-33, DEC-35); this is why "stay as now" is recommended there, and the item notes say what exactly is already in the game.

1. Barracks and "Defense": B2 "Building and rampart" (B3, B4 in the same table)

Mockup objects-style.html (block 3, decision #337, ui-style 28). Since then the barracks and the "Defense" sign were reworked again: D1 diamond pips and L1 left column (#349, ui-style 35, the owner's choice 2026-10-29).

B2 Building and rampartThe barracks as a small building on the city territory next to the node (construction dashed with scaffolding and a bar); "Defense" as a rampart ring of rhombi around the city, one per cap slot (filled = gathered), the opponent a double ring without rhombi.no / no / no / yesM, 3-4 days (incl. replacing defenseLayout.ts, defenseSigns.ts, defenseView.ts, visual references)about 0.9-1.0medium: the ring crosses the VP badge, the warehouse places and the roads; where the building goes on a dense map; it undoes D1/L1 a day after they were chosen

Recommendation: stay as now. The problem B2 was meant to solve (a weak, duplicated "Defense" sign) was solved on 2026-10-29 by D1 + L1, which the owner chose from six counters and three placements; B2's ring adds the most overlap at exactly the place #349 cleaned up (VP badge, warehouse places, roads). If the owner wants more "character" of the territory, the only piece worth a separate small issue is the B2 building for the barracks (not the rampart), as a replacement of the house icon.
Owner's decision: awaiting the owner's decision (stay as now / B2 / B3 / B4 / only the B2 building).

2. Fog: BL3-2 "Memory" and BL3-3 "Line of sight"

Mockup map-style-2.html (block 3, decision #335, ui-style 26). BL3-1 "Haze" (F1) was chosen against the recommended BL3-2 and is implemented in #346; DEC-33 later added memory ghosts with their age (-0:21) and DEC-35 unveiled the own territory.

VariantWhat changesDEC / protocol / sim / clientEstimateFPSRisk
Now: BL3-1 HazeA 66% veil with a soft edge over the cities in fog (Voronoi cells, one cached blur layer); the memory is a ghost marker with its age, the veil never depends on seen (fogLayout.ts).–0about 0.66 with the cacheimplemented
BL3-2 MemoryThree states: visible; "seen" (the veil darkens with the age of seen.tick, hatching); "never" (a dark veil, dots, "?"). TilingSprite patterns, cached layers.no / no / no / yes (NodeView.seen, HalfView.seen with tick exist)M, 2-3 daysabout 0.7-0.9low-medium: more states, a hint in the legend is needed; part of its value (how old a sighting is) is already given by the ghost age labels
BL3-3 Line of sightA grainy veil, a dashed border of what is seen, a tick on the road at the border point, roads fading into the fog.no / see the note / no / yesM, 3 daysabout 0.8-1.0medium: small signs compete with the R1 lanes and the packets

BL3-3 and the data. On 2026-10-21 the mockup marked BL3-3 as needing protocol and DEC-21 data in PlayerView (#233, #329) for the border of vision by edge halves, and it was not proposed as the main one for that reason. Both issues are closed now: the view carries EdgeView.halves[].detail (DEC-21 item 5, DEC-35), the map file carries border_permille, and the client already computes the border point (fogLayout.borderPoint). By my reading of gow_protocol.view no new field is needed any more; the implementation issue should confirm this before the estimate is final.

Recommendation: stay as now. The owner chose the haze over BL3-2 when BL3-2 was the recommendation; since then the ghosts with their age (DEC-33) cover the "how old is what I know" part, and DEC-35's vision rules changed what the fog means. Second choice: BL3-2 for the "never seen" state alone (the dark veil and "?"), S-M, if playtests show players cannot tell scouted land from unknown land. BL3-3 is feasible now but adds small signs to the roads, which the release does not need.
Owner's decision: awaiting the owner's decision (stay as now / BL3-2 / BL3-3 / BL3-2 "never seen" only).

Recommendation: stay as now (SH1). SH1 is implemented, measured and tuned for the distance 46 (the chosen placement); every other variant is 3-4 days plus a new FPS measurement and new visual references, for a look the owner already compared on 2026-10-21. If the owner still wants the shots to be "less banal" before the release, take SH5: it is the only one built from the game's own language (■ charge, a battery), the cheapest per frame, and its cancellation looks like a collision.
Owner's decision: awaiting the owner's decision (stay as now / SH2 / SH3 / SH4 / SH5).

Recommendation: CT1 "Tally on the plate". It says what the round was (real, bonus, cancelled, a kill) where the player already looks during a fight, stays after the tracers fade, uses only the fields the view already has, adds no moving object, and is the cheapest. Second: CT2. Open question: with combat.shots_per_round = 1 the per-round count is always 1, so CT1 could show the glyph alone; the example "● 2 ◇ 1" of #516 reads like fight totals (CT4), which would need a protocol field.
